summary: A six-track instrument for generative ambient music, evolving soundscapes and rhythms, built around a large library of preset scenes called Biomes.
features: Synth voices, lo-fi kits and hand percussion with a shared granular bus
Sequence recording, chord progressions, "Living Links" and "Biome Drift"
MIDI Learn, USB display mirroring and multichannel USB recording
Returning to stock firmware can erase user banks and settings

headings: mutable dreams 2.0 for the m-vave fm-1
